say:1:1121106001:0.text: Who are you? Where are you from? Who are you looking for?
say:1:1121106001:0.source_cn: 你是谁？从哪里来的？要找谁？

say:2:1121106002:0.text: Apologies, I do not have the answers to these questions either. However, I can sense a special presence in this area. The person I'm looking for must have been around here...
say:2:1121106002:0.source_cn: 十分抱歉，这些问题我也不知道。不过我能在附近感受到特殊...

say:3:1121106003:0.text: Is it just me, or is it getting warmer? I hope it isn't another fire...
say:3:1121106003:0.source_cn: 我说，附近是不是变热了……？不会又发生火灾吧？

say:6:1121106004:0.text: She seems to be lost. Should we ask the Heroic Order for help?
say:6:1121106004:0.source_cn: 看起来她也说不清楚情况，要不要找骑士团的人帮忙？

choice_prompt:7:1121106004.text: She seems to be lost. Should we ask the Heroic Order for help?

say:9:1121106005:0.text: I sense your power... You're the one I've been looking for!
say:9:1121106005:0.source_cn: 你身上的力量……没错，你就是我在找的人！
say:9:1121106005:0.male: I sense your power... You're the one I've been looking for!
say:9:1121106005:0.female: I sense your power... You're the one I've been looking for!

say:14:1121106008:1.text: Wait! Stand back! I sense an evil presence!
say:14:1121106008:1.source_cn: ——等等，你们退后！有邪恶的气息！

narration:21:11010211:0.text: While inquiring about the mysterious lady's identity, a Hypofiend emerges out of nowhere! Talene swiftly positions herself in front of the Ryeham citizens.
narration:21:11010211:0.source_cn: 询问神秘女性的身份时，突然有魔物出现！塔琳闪身挡在金穗...
